Use this template to submit new content to the Soilharmony Catalogue.
Records are preferably included by DOI. 
You can submit a list of DOI (one DOI per line) via below template.

**`Motivation for inclusion`** *(required)*  

**`List of DOI's`** *(required)*  

Alternatively, you can reference a file on the web or on the projects sharepoint. 
In this scenario submit a single record only and populate the inline metadata  

**`Url to file`** *(required)*  

**`Metadata`** *(required)*  
---
identifier:

abstract:
type: [article,dataset,software,function,descriptor,method]
publication-date: 20yy-mm-dd
creator:
subject:
license: [closed|CC-0|CC-BY|CC-BY-ND|CC-BY-NC]
spatial coverage:
temporal coverage:
funding: https://doi.org/10.3030/xxxxxxxxx
